title: Why Indians Are Protesting
gist: Promo page for an FP Live interview with Pratap Bhanu Mehta on India's prolonged protests, which center on election integrity and build on anger over inflation, jobs and accountability, with Modi's 12-year hold on power showing rare signs of slipping. Page also lists other FP Live episode blurbs (Spain vs Trump, AI governance in US vs China, UNDP in wartime, Mike Waltz).

insights.claim: Narendra Modi's 12-year hold on power is showing rare signs of slipping amid a prolonged period of protest.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: Political risk in India is rising from low levels; watch protest momentum and electoral institutions.

insights.claim: The latest Indian demonstrations center on election integrity but build on anger over inflation, job creation and a perceived lack of accountability.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: Cost-of-living and employment grievances are the economic root of the unrest, a domestic-demand and policy risk.
insights.locator: The latest demonstrations center on questions about election integrity

insights.claim: Spain under Pedro Sanchez has clashed with the Trump administration on Iran, Israel, Venezuela and NATO funding, Trump called it a terrible partner and threatened to cut off trade, and a snap election is set for Nov. 29.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: US-Spain trade threats and a snap election are watch items for Spanish assets.
insights.locator: Why Spain Is Standing Up to Trump

insights.claim: Anthropic withheld Mythos and OpenAI scrapped the launch of GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns, and Trump then convened AI executives to sign a voluntary accord, while Matt Sheehan notes China regulates AI extensively yet its companies are catching up.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: Frontier AI release restraint and the US-China regulation contrast are relevant to AI sector policy risk.

insights.claim: The Trump administration has withdrawn from more than 30 U.N. entities and cut the UN budget, reflecting a US pullback from multilateral institutions.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: US multilateral retreat reduces funding for UN and aid programs.
insights.locator: Mike Waltz on Trump’s Global Strategy
